3609-to-morrow.title: To-morrow?
3609-to-morrow.creator: Victoria Cross
3609-to-morrow.description: A book by Victoria Cross. What need to tell me that I possessed a power that inflamed every vein, that heated all the blood in my system, that filled, till they seemed buoyant, every cell of my brain? As much need as to tell the expectant mother she has a life within her own.

arxiv-1812-03350.title: Adaptive and Calibrated Ensemble Learning with Dependent Tail-free Process
arxiv-1812-03350.creator: Jeremiah Zhe Liu John Paisley Marianthi-Anna Kioumourtzoglou Brent A. Coull
arxiv-1812-03350.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Jeremiah Zhe Liu John Paisley Marianthi-Anna Kioumourtzoglou Brent A. Coull. 1 Introduction Ensemble learning is a mainstay in many modern machine-learning systems interacting with real-world data [ 14 ] . Conventional ensemble algorithms assign to base models a set of deterministic, constant model weights, not fully accounting for variability in the base model’s ability to capture different aspects of the data-generation mechanism, nor providing uncertainty estimates for the ensemble prediction.

arxiv-2011-05602.title: Joint predictions of multi-modal ride-hailing demands: a deep multi-task multi-graph learning-based approach
arxiv-2011-05602.creator: Jintao Ke, Siyuan Feng, Zheng Zhu, Hai Yang, Jieping Ye
arxiv-2011-05602.description: Abstract Ride-hailing platforms generally provide various service options to customers, such as solo ride services, shared ride services, etc. It is generally expected that demands for different service modes are correlated, and the prediction of demand for one service mode can benefit from historical observations of demands for other service modes.

arxiv-2105-08171.title: On the Structure Tensor of 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 n \mathfrak{sl}_{n} Thanks: Author was supported by the Mathematics Department at Texas A&M University and NSF grant AF-1814254.
arxiv-2105-08171.creator: Kashif K. Bari
arxiv-2105-08171.description: Abstract . The structure tensor of 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 n \mathfrak{sl}_{n} , denoted T 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 n T_{\mathfrak{sl}_{n}} , is the tensor arising from the Lie bracket bilinear operation on the set of traceless n × n n\times n matrices over ℂ \mathbb{C} . This tensor is intimately related to the well studied matrix multiplication tensor.

arxiv-2108-09421.title: Mellin-Barnes integrals and the method of brackets
arxiv-2108-09421.creator: Ivan Gonzalez, Igor Kondrashuk, Victor H. Moll, Luis M. Recabarren
arxiv-2108-09421.description: Abstract . The method of brackets is a method for the evaluation of definite integrals based on a small number of rules. This is employed here for the evaluation of Mellin-Barnes integral. The fundamental idea is to transform these integral representations into a bracket series to obtain their values.

arxiv-2109-13229.title: Ultrafast renormalization of the onsite Coulomb repulsion in a cuprate superconductor
arxiv-2109-13229.creator: Denitsa R. Baykusheva, Hoyoung Jang, Ali A. Husain, Sangjun Lee, Sophia F. R. TenHuisen, Preston Zhou, Sunwook Park, Hoon Kim, Jinkwang Kim, Hyeong-Do Kim, Minseok Kim, Sang-Youn Park, Peter Abbamonte, B. J. Kim, G. D. Gu, Yao Wang, Matteo Mitrano
arxiv-2109-13229.description: Abstract Ultrafast lasers are an increasingly important tool to control and stabilize emergent phases in quantum materials. Among a variety of possible excitation protocols, a particularly intriguing route is the direct light-engineering of microscopic electronic parameters, such as the electron hopping and the local Coulomb repulsion (Hubbard U U ).

arxiv-2305-03194.title: Testing and Learning Convex Sets in the Ternary Hypercube This paper is an updated and significantly expanded version of an earlier preprint [ BBH23 ] .
arxiv-2305-03194.creator: Hadley Black, Eric Blais, Nathaniel Harms
arxiv-2305-03194.description: Abstract We study the problems of testing and learning high-dimensional discrete convex sets. The simplest high-dimensional discrete domain where convexity is a non-trivial property is the ternary hypercube , { − 1 , 0 , 1 } n \{-1,0,1\}^{n} .

arxiv-2311-06561.title: Efficient Raman lasing and Raman-Kerr interaction in an integrated silicon carbide platform Journal: osajournal Publication type: article
arxiv-2311-06561.creator: Jingwei Li \authormark 1+, Ruixuan Wang \authormark 1+, Adnan A. Afridi \authormark 2, Yaoqin Lu \authormark 2, Xiaodong Shi \authormark 2, Wenhan Sun \authormark 1, Haiyan Ou \authormark 2, and Qing Li \authormark 1, Jingwei Li \authormark 1+, Ruixuan Wang \authormark 1+, Adnan A. Afridi \authormar
arxiv-2311-06561.description: Abstract Implementing stimulated Raman scattering in a low-loss microresonator could lead to Raman lasing. Here, we report the demonstration of an efficient Raman laser with > 50 % >50\% power efficiency in an integrated silicon carbide platform for the first time.

arxiv-2404-02054.title: Deconstructing In-Context Learning: Understanding Prompts via Corruption
arxiv-2404-02054.description: Abstract The ability of large language models (LLMs) to “learn in contex” based on the provided prompt has led to an explosive growth in their use, culminating in the proliferation of AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Bard. These AI assistants are known to be robust to minor prompt modifications, mostly due to alignment techniques that use human feedback.

arxiv-2408-14628.title: Investigating Late-Time Dark Energy and Massive Neutrinos in Light of DESI Y1 BAO

arxiv-2408-14628.description: Abstract Baryonic Acoustic Oscillation (BAO) data from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI), in combination with Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) data and Type Ia Supernovae (SN) luminosity distances, suggests a dynamical evolution of the dark energy equation of state with a phantom phase ( w < − 1 w<-1 ) in the past when the so-called w 0 ​ w

arxiv-2501-09998.title: An in-depth study of Gamma rays from the Starburst Galaxy M 82 with VERITAS
arxiv-2501-09998.creator: A. Acharyya, C. B. Adams, P. Bangale, J. T. Bartkoske, W. Benbow, Y. Chen, J. L. Christiansen, A. J. Chromey, A. Duerr, M. Errando, M. Escobar Godoy, A. Falcone, S. Feldman, Q. Feng, J. Foote, L. Fortson, A. Furniss, W. Hanlon, D. Hanna, O. Hervet, C. E. Hinrichs, J. Holder, T. B. Humensky, W. Jin,
arxiv-2501-09998.description: Abstract Assuming Galactic cosmic rays originate in supernovae and the winds of massive stars, starburst galaxies should produce very-high-energy (VHE; E > > 100 GeV) gamma-ray emission via the interaction of their copious quantities of cosmic rays with the large reservoirs of dense gas within the galaxies.

arxiv-2508-20231.title: Bounds on Perfect Node Classification: A Convex Graph Clustering Perspective
arxiv-2508-20231.creator: Firooz Shahriari-Mehr, Ashkan Panahi, Javad Aliakbari, Alexandre Graell i Amat
arxiv-2508-20231.description: Abstract We present an analysis of the transductive node classification problem, where the underlying graph consists of communities that agree with the node labels and node features. For node classification, we propose a novel optimization problem that incorporates the node-specific information (labels and features) in a spectral graph clustering framework.

arxiv-2511-20934.title: Guaranteed Optimal Compositional Explanations for Neurons
arxiv-2511-20934.creator: Biagio La Rosa, Leilani H. Gilpin
arxiv-2511-20934.description: Abstract While neurons are the basic units of deep neural networks, it is still unclear what they learn and if their knowledge is aligned with that of humans. Compositional explanations aim to answer this question by describing the spatial alignment between neuron activations and concepts through logical rules.

pmc-10521340.title: Systolic inter-arm blood pressure difference and estimated glomerular filtration rate in type 2 diabetic patients in Palestine: a cross-sectional study

pmc-10521340.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to investigate the association between systolic inter-arm blood pressure difference (IABPD) and the estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), as well as chronic kidney disease (CKD), in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).Patients and methodsThis cross-sectional study included 189 Palestinians diagnosed with T2DM.

pmc-11392172.title: Unravelling the molecular landscape of endometrial cancer subtypes: insights from multiomics analysis
pmc-11392172.creator: Yufei Shen, Yan Tian, Jiashan Ding, Zhuo Chen, Rong Zhao, Yingnan Lu, Lucia Li, Hui Zhang, Haiyue Wu, Xi Li, Yu Zhang
pmc-11392172.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background:Endometrial cancer (EC) as one of the most common gynecologic malignancies is increasing in incidence during the past 10 years. Genome-Wide Association Studies (GWAS) extended to metabolic and protein phenotypes inspired us to employ multiomics methods to analyze the causal relationships of plasma metabolites and proteins with EC to advance our understanding of EC biology and pave the way for more targeted approaches to its diagnosis and treatment by comparing the molecular profiles of different EC subtypes.Methods:Two-sample mendelian randomization (MR) was performed

pmc-11437851.title: Pathology and physiology of acid-sensitive ion channels in the bladder
pmc-11437851.creator: Yang Zhang, Di Dong, Jialong Zhang, Kang Cheng, Fang Zhen, Mei Li, Binghai Chen
pmc-11437851.description: Acid-sensitive ion channels (ASICs) are sodium-permeable channels activated by extracellular acidification. They can be activated and trigger the inward flow of Na+ when the extracellular environment is acidic, leading to membrane depolarization and thus inducing action potentials in neurons. There are four ASIC genes in mammals (ASIC1–4). ASIC is widely expressed in humans.

pmc-11464666.title: Metabolomic profiling reveals the step-wise alteration of bile acid metabolism in patients with diabetic kidney disease
pmc-11464666.creator: Qing Zhang, Liqian Lu, Jiao Wang, Manman Lu, Dongwei Liu, Chunyu Zhou, Zhangsuo Liu
pmc-11464666.description: BackgroundDiabetic kidney disease (DKD) is the major complication of diabetes concomitant with gut dysbiosis and glycometabolic disorder, which are strongly associated with bile acid (BA) metabolism. Yet studies investigating the BA metabolism involving in DKD pathogenesis are limited. This study aimed to explore the metabolomic profiling of BAs in DKD and analyze its association with DKD progression.

pmc-11504397.title: Sharing and Allocation in Preschool Children: The Roles of Theory of Mind, Anticipated Emotions, and Consequential Emotions
pmc-11504397.creator: Yingdi Shi, Mengnan Zhang, Liqi Zhu, Xiaochun Xie
pmc-11504397.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study investigates the impact of theory of mind, anticipated emotions before actual behavior, and consequential emotions following the behavior on sharing and allocation behavior in 4–6-year-old children. In Experiment 1, 95 children were randomly assigned to three conditions (external emotion expectancy condition, internal emotion expectancy condition, and control condition) to explore the role of cognition and emotions in children’s sharing and allocation behaviors.

pmc-12516832.title: Clinical characteristics of Mycoplasma pneumoniae compared to Streptococcus pneumoniae in hospitalized adults with community-acquired pneumonia- a prospective study
pmc-12516832.creator: Karin Hansen, Lisa Wasserstrom, Jonas Ahl, Anna C. Nilsson, Kristian Riesbeck
pmc-12516832.description: BackgroundStreptococcus pneumoniae is the primary cause of hospitalized community-acquired pneumonia (CAP). Mycoplasma pneumoniae, though typically causing mild respiratory disease, can lead to pneumonia requiring hospitalization in adults. This study compared patients hospitalized with CAP caused by M. pneumoniae or S. pneumoniae aiming at increasing the understanding of when to sample for and empirically treat M. pneumoniae.

pmc-12555510.title: Psychotropic use and psychotropic polypharmacy in intellectual disability - a national cohort study
pmc-12555510.creator: V Virtanen, L Saastamoinen, A Teittinen, H Vesala, S Miettinen, M Arvio, A M Tolppanen
pmc-12555510.description: IntroductionPsychotropic medication use and psychotropic polypharmacy are common in people with intellectual disabilities. However, representative, population-based studies on this topic are scarce. We evaluated the prevalence of psychotropic use and psychotropic polypharmacy in a Finnish nationwide cohort of people with intellectual disabilities.

pmc-12592528.title: Preparation of doped Mn, N-CDs and their application in the detection of ampicillin
pmc-12592528.creator: Min Ye, Yinying Zhang, Pengpeng Ding, Lifen Meng
pmc-12592528.description: In this study, a one-step hydrothermal method was employed to synthesise highly fluorescent carbon quantum dots (Mn, N-CDs), incorporating the metallic element manganese (Mn) and the non-metallic element nitrogen (N). Banana peels and potassium permanganate were utilised as the raw materials.

pmc-12781441.title: Association between serum 25(OH)D, oxidative balance score, and mortality among individuals with metabolic syndrome: a cohort study
pmc-12781441.creator: Xuena Zhang, Xiaobing Feng, Jie Liu, Xiaohui Zhang, Qian Zhou, Yu Xu, Wenjuan Wang, Wanjun Luo
pmc-12781441.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the separate, joint, as well as interactive associations of serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D [25(OH)D] concentrations and oxidative balance score (OBS) with mortality among individuals with metabolic syndrome (MetS).MethodsThe analysis included 12,078 participants with MetS from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2001–2018. Mortality was ascertained by linkage to National Death Index records through 31 December 2019.

pmc-13137960.title: HSPA6 Promotes Ferroptosis in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer by Rewiring Lipid Metabolism to Potentiate Membrane Lipid Peroxidation
pmc-13137960.creator: Lin-Yue Hai, Zhi-Hao Yu, Wen-Bo Liu, Yuan-Yuan Zhang, Yue Xu, Shan Cheng, Hao-Ran Yue, Zhang-Yin Guo, Shi-Jie Yan, Rui Sun, Xiao-Feng Liu, Bo-Wen Liu, Xin Wang, Xu-Chen Cao, Yue Yu
pmc-13137960.description: Given the lack of effective targeted therapeutic options for triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), there is an imperative demand for innovative treatment approaches, with ferroptosis standing out as a promising direction. This study identifies HSPA6 as a key ferroptosis sensitizer in TNBC.

pmc-13624464.title: Frequency and pattern of p16 expression in neuroendocrine neoplasms
pmc-13624464.creator: Hasan Saeed, Nadira Mamoon
pmc-13624464.description: Objectives:To determine the frequency and pattern of p16 expression in neuroendocrine neoplasms and evaluate its association with tumor types and grades.Methodology:This prospective descriptive study was conducted at the Department of Histopathology, Shifa International Hospital, Islamabad, from November 2024 to October 2025. A total of 85 cases of NENs were included using a non-probability consecutive sampling technique.

pmc-13677060.title: Potential geographic distribution and host utilization of Alectorobius puertoricensis (Ixodida: Argasidae) in the Caribbean Basin: a putative vector of African swine fever virus
pmc-13677060.creator: Taylor G Donaldson, Hsiao-Hsuan Wang, Charluz M Arocho Rosario, Pete D Teel, William E Grant, Gabriel L Hamer, Kathleen C O’Hara, Angela M James, Phillip E Kaufman
pmc-13677060.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Alectorobius puertoricensis (Fox 1947) (Ixodida: Argasidae) is a nidicolous soft tick distributed throughout the Caribbean Basin and has been experimentally shown to transmit African swine fever virus (ASFV). Given the reemergence of African swine fever (ASF) in the Caribbean in 2021, defining the potential distribution, host utilization, and environmental conditions of this tick species is essential for assessing its regional ASFV risk in the western hemisphere. This study compiled historical occurrence records and hosts associated with A.
